text: K-Tech | Homepage Dial in . Full Control . Provalve plug & play tunable suspension tech. PROVALVE Road Off-Road From road to rough . Confidence starts with suspension you can trust. K-Tech has redefined the ride of the Yamaha Tenere 700 and Honda CRF300L with suspension upgrades that keep you riding longer with less fatigue. Born on dirt. Raised on tarmac . At home where the winners are. You’re bound to see us across road and off-road racing circuits, learn more about what puts us there. A work of non-friction . For over twenty years K-Tech have built on their incredible success in global road racing and motocross championships, constantly evolving and providing championship winning products.
